create attribute isInitial in State type boolean
create attribute isFinal in State type boolean

# Events that trigger transitions

create attribute name in Event type String

# Actions associated with transitions or states (e.g., logging)

create attribute name in Action type String
create attribute description in Action type String

create attribute name in StateMachine type String

create attribute name in State type String
create attribute isComposite in State type boolean

create class NormalState
create class CompositeState
